## Verdict

wrong

## Bearer

RaceDetailViewModel — app-phone/src/main/java/com/mgilli/hyroxtracker/ui/racedetail/RaceDetailViewModel.kt, `buildRow`

## Trigger

`buildCycles` calls `buildRow` for every one of the 30 indices when
`RaceDetailViewModel.uiState` recombines `raceRepository.observeAll()` and
`observeReference()` — observed, part of the screen's own flow.

## Today

`buildRow` (line 173) holds `segment`, the row's own `Segment` with its
`type`, but never reads it when deciding whether to render a delta.
Whenever `referenceSegment?.durationMs` is non-null it computes
`delta = DisplayFormatter.formatDelta(DurationTruncationService
.truncateToSeconds(durationMs - referenceDurationMs))` — a plain
truncated subtraction against the reference race's same-index segment —
for all thirty rows, run and non-run alike. `LapDeltaCalculator`
(`core-domain/src/main/kotlin/com/mgilli/core/domain/sensor/
LapDeltaCalculator.kt`), the calculation the technical document names
for the lap delta, is never called from this file or from anywhere in
`app-phone`; its `compute(pace, expectedDistanceM, referenceDurationMs,
elapsedInSegmentMs)` is a live, pace-derived projection meant for a
race in progress, and `RaceDetailViewModel` only ever renders a stored,
finished race.

## Expected

The delta column shows a value only on the rows a calculation actually
covers, and nothing on the rest. The gap names two things §3.4 does not
state: what the twenty-two non-run rows are backed by (today: the same
plain subtraction as the eight run rows, gated only on the reference
segment's duration being present, never on `SegmentType.RUN`), and what
"lap delta" means once the race is over — §3.4 defines it strictly as a
live, continuously-recomputed projection from an in-progress segment's
pace, which no longer applies to a segment that has already closed and
been persisted. Fixing this requires stating, for a finished race, which
calculation (if any) backs a RUN row's delta and which backs the
twenty-two non-run rows — `buildRow` cannot be corrected against §3.4
alone, since §3.4 covers a live race, not a stored one.
